text: Binary per-row check on the `argument` column only (the OP's current supplied text, including marked edits, not removed or reconstructed as an initial snapshot): returns 1 if the OP's own voice contains at least one explicit first-person singular pronoun (I, me, my, mine, myself, and contractions like I'm/I've/I'd/I'll), else 0. Ignored text: OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the view changed or the outcome occurred (e.g. "my view was changed", "Δ awarded", "thanks, you changed my mind"). Pronouns only in those parts don't count. Also ignored: pronouns only inside quotations of others' words the OP doesn't adopt, and moderator/bot notices. Generic discussion of platform or delta rules still counts if it has such a pronoun in the OP's voice. Missing or malformed argument gives null; an empty string gives 0.
